title: Basic Commands [echo + >> / >]
description:
# echo
---
`echo` has two uses. Printing to console, and appending to the end of a file. `echo "TEXT"` would print to console TEXT. `echo "TEXT" >> FILE_NAME` appends to the end of a file. `echo "TEXT" > FILE_NAME` overwrites a file.
